case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We thank you for your prompt response and the alternative proposals. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We value our long-standing partnership and are willing to extend the contract term to 24 months to provide mutual planning security. With this longer commitment and maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms, we can revise our offer to €51.30 per unit. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

It is always a pleasure working alongside your team, and we look forward to continuing our trusted cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have received your updated term sheets and note the slight increase in your proposed prices. To demonstrate our continued commitment to our partnership, we are prepared to lower our offer to €51.10 per unit for a 24-month contract with 30-day payment terms. Our current Angebot comprises a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

As your adjustment was quite small, we must ask for a more significant step from your side to bridge the remaining gap. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your continued movement and the revised proposals. Over the many years of our shared history, our family foundry has always valued working closely with our partners, and we take great pride in the quality of the work our team delivers. 

In response, we are prepared to reduce our price to €50.70 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our proposal remains valid for 7 days. 

We are making steady progress and I am confident we will reach a fair agreement soon. It would be our true pleasure to continue serving your respected company with the reliability you have known from our region for generations.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
